artist.name: Lizzy McAlpine
artist.short_description: Lizzy McAlpine is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Lizzy McAlpine is an American singer-songwriter associated with detailed storytelling, acoustic arrangements and an increasingly expansive alternative-pop and folk sound. She released Give Me a Minute in 2020, then reached a wider audience through 2022's five seconds flat and the renewed attention around 'ceilings.' The 2024 album Older represented a deliberate change in her recording and performance priorities, emphasizing a more live, organic atmosphere and lyrics that look at personal responsibility as well as hurt. Her later catalogue includes Older (and Wiser) and the 2026 album Angel. In interviews, McAlpine has discussed both the mixed experience of a viral song and the importance of making music that feels personally authentic. Her comments on 'ceilings' specifically connect the song to the memory of an ended relationship. For Afterglow, this is a particularly suitable bridge between quiet singer-songwriter material and the heightened storytelling of emotional pop. The curated songs here draw from several album eras; track-specific release dates should be distinguished from reissues, album placements and viral rediscovery.
